name: tm-edpa
notes: tm-edpa is NOT vendored as a copy any more. The hub marketplace.json source points directly to technomaton/edpa@plugin, so `/plugin install tm-edpa@technomaton-hub` fetches the plugin payload (skills, commands, hooks, .mcp.json, Python engine, schemas, templates, workflows) straight from upstream.

`pinned` records the upstream tag/SHA the hub currently advertises. Bumping it requires editing this file and the corresponding section in CHANGELOG/README — Claude Code's marketplace will pick the bumped ref up automatically.

If we ever need to pin a specific upstream ref (e.g. for compliance), add `ref: <tag>` to the source object in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Today the source resolves to the default branch HEAD of technomaton/edpa.

The legacy auto-sync workflow .github/workflows/sync-edpa.yml is obsolete under this model — it can be removed once we've shipped a release on the pointer model and confirmed marketplace installs work.
